summaryZh: Griffith Lab研究复杂能源材料的合成、结构与功能关系，目标包括改进储能电极、固体电解质及其他功能陶瓷。研究结合无机材料合成、光谱与衍射、计算化学、器件制备，以及具有时空分辨率的X射线和中子研究。
researchQuestions: 复杂能源材料的合成和结构如何决定功能？
如何将机制认识转化为电极、固体电解质及功能陶瓷的改进？
methods: 时空分辨X射线与中子研究

Primary Research Area Physical Chemistry Materials Chemistry
We are an interdisciplinary research group investigating synthesis–structure–function relationships in complex energy-related materials.

Our research bridges inorganic materials synthesis, advanced spectroscopy and diffraction techniques, applied computational chemistry, and device fabrication for property and performance characterization.

The overarching goal is translating mechanistic insights into advances for electrodes and solid electrolytes for electrochemical energy storage as well as other functional ceramics with, e.g., optical activity, separation selectivity, or negative thermal expansion.
Beyond the lab, we work closely with national and international particle accelerator facilities to design and execute detailed spatially and temporally resolved studies with X-rays and neutrons.
